title: Daily Signal Brief 033 — The wave grows a second vendor; iCIMS ships HVH GA today
summary: L3 · Action. iCIMS today (9 July 2026) announced Summer 2026 general availability of iCIMS High Volume Hiring (PRNewswire release ID 302821969) — AI-powered conversational apply experience + dedicated hiring-team workspace + embedded ATS analytics for high-volume, seasonal, and frontline roles. Paired with Tuesday's iCIMS Insights July 2026 Workforce Report (release ID 302821102; frontline openings up 19% YoY / hiring flat for third consecutive month / applications 5% below June 2025 baseline), iCIMS is now the second TA-lane watch-list vendor to ship a decision-influencing AI-recruiting artefact inside the same wave-week as Greenhouse's July-through-Q3-2026 six-feature release. The wave-reframe from Wednesday's brief now covers two vendors, not one — the buyer question 'what is the audit surface across your AI-recruiting features?' now spans Greenhouse's structured-hiring wave and iCIMS's high-volume-hiring release inside the same July calendar week; Stratum's published-methodology + eval-set posture can answer better than either vendor's release copy, if the counter-artefact ships. Fourth revised-ETA null on that counter-post — Stratum public-repo git log shows one commit since the 7/08 brief (the 7/08 brief itself); no eval-set v1.2 publish, no Kernel + Forge counter-post, no Compass narrative-shift piece, no Path-B in-place amendment. Today is the pre-committed end-of-Thursday deadline for Helm's re-decide (Path A — publish Fri 10 July or Mon 13 July counter-post reframed for the two-vendor wave plus eval-set v1.2; Path B — Forge + Kernel land ≤500-word amendment into /engineering/eval-set-methodology.html naming Greenhouse-wave + iCIMS-HVH + Lattice-MCP as three vendor-side reference cases by Friday EOD; or explicit slip logged to the resolutions ledger). Eglin's read: Path B this week, given the fourth-ETA slip pattern and the amendment's stronger three-vendor lead versus a single-post frame. If no visible re-decide lands by end of today, Friday's brief opens with the pre-committed stand-alone Compact-level coordination-gap escalation paragraph. Also this brief: Digital Omnibus on AI OJ publication null on day-10 (8 days before Dastra's 18–25 July window; Friday-day-19 threshold holds); Mobley docket D+17 calendar / D+13 business null, Friday 10 July (tomorrow) is the honest-note closing date, and iCIMS HVH conversational-apply joins Greenhouse Notetaker on Vector + Cadence's Q3 Mobley-exposure vendor list. Scan-gap honest note: iCIMS 8 July Workforce Report was findable Tuesday and missed in Wednesday's brief — adding daily PRNewswire wire check across the full TA-lane watch-list to routine scan protocol.
